newsitem.title: USA: CSW seeks power from renewable resources.
newsitem.headline: CSW seeks power from renewable resources.

text.p: Central and South West Services Inc said Friday it will issue on June 10 a Request for Proposals (RFP) for the procurement of up to 75 megawatts of renewable energy resources on behalf of Central Power and Light Co, West Texas Utilities Co, and Southwestern Electric Power Co.
All of the companies are owned and operated by Central and South West Corp.
The renewable energy resources procured through this solicitation must be commercially available not later than June 1, 1999, the company said.
It said the requests are being issued as a part of the CSW's Integrated Resource Plan, which was filed with the Public Utility Commission of Texas in January.

An energy resource mix that included renewable resources was strongly advocated by customers during three Deliberative Polls held last year at each of the three CSW Texas operating companies, it pointed out.
